description: Read-only. Puts 2-6 industries side by side for one metric: median multiple, middle 50% (25th-75th percentile) and deal count n per industry, using the same data, name matching and thresholds as get_valuation_multiples. Without size_bracket it compares all-deal-size medians (n>=5); with size_bracket it compares that enterprise-value bracket (n>=10). Rows below the threshold are marked INSUFFICIENT DATA rather than estimated; unmatched names and industry-group ids are flagged per row. Use it for 'which sells for more, X or Y?' questions; use get_valuation_multiples for the full breakdown of one industry.

industries.description: 2 to 6 sub-vertical ids or plain-English industry names to compare, e.g. ['dental-practice', 'veterinary-practice', 'physical therapy'].

items.description: Sub-vertical id from list_industries (e.g. 'hvac', 'dental-practice'), or a plain-English name ('HVAC', 'dentist', 'plumber', 'MSP'); plain names are mapped to the closest tracked category and the answer says which one was used.

metric.description: Multiple to compare: ev_ebitda (enterprise value / EBITDA, default) or ev_revenue (enterprise value / revenue).

size_bracket.description: Optional enterprise-value (deal size) bracket: under_5m_ev = under $5M, 5m_25m_ev = $5M-$25M, 25m_100m_ev = $25M-$100M, 100m_500m_ev = $100M-$500M, over_500m_ev = $500M and up. Omit to compare all deal sizes pooled.

name: compare_industries
title: Compare industries' M&A multiples
